SOUMITA BHATTACHARJEE

Bengaluru, India | 6364758285 | sbhattacharjee2912@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/soumita-bhattacharjee-463852154

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Results-driven Project Manager with 11+ years of experience delivering large-scale, regulated technology and transformation programs across global banking and financial services organizations (Standard Chartered, Northern Trust). Proven track record in portfolio governance, financial control, RAID and risk management, stakeholder engagement and Agile delivery (Certified SAFe Agilist). Skilled in managing multi-million-dollar regulatory change programs, driving executive-level reporting and ensuring audit and regulatory readiness within highly controlled banking environments. Adept at partnering with Finance, Technology, Business and PMO teams to deliver measurable outcomes.

CORE COMPETENCIES

Project & Portfolio Governance • Financial Management & Budgeting • RAID & Risk Management • Stakeholder & Vendor Management • Change Request Governance • Regulatory & Audit Compliance • Resource & Capacity Planning • Agile / SAFe Delivery • Executive & Steering Committee Reporting • Banking & Financial Services Domain Expertise • Clarity • JIRA • Azure DevOps (ADO) • Confluence • SharePoint • MS Excel • Tableau

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Specialist – Change Management	Apr 2025 – Present

Apptad Technologies – Client: Standard Chartered, Bengaluru

Managed governance, delivery oversight, financial controls, and stakeholder engagement across multiple portfolios, including Risk Monitoring & Insights (RMI), CFCR TOM, Risk Advice, and KTLO initiatives.

Led daily delivery forums, portfolio reviews and cross-functional stakeholder meetings to track progress, resolve issues and drive execution against strategic objectives.

Established and maintained comprehensive RAID governance, proactively managing risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies and mitigation plans across change and BAU portfolios.

Developed executive-level governance artifacts including status reports, steering committee packs, leadership updates and fortnightly business review materials.

Drove portfolio financial management including forecasting, variance analysis, accruals, recharges, budget tracking, financial reporting and investment governance; partnered with Finance, Business, Technology, AI and PMO teams to improve forecast accuracy and budget controls.

Managed resource planning and governance including capacity management, workforce forecasting, timesheet compliance, allocation management and CAPEX tracking.

Led Change Request governance through template development, impact assessments, stakeholder reviews, approval coordination and implementation tracking.

Ensured portfolio data integrity by managing Clarity and Azure DevOps (ADO) updates, resolving data quality issues and improving reporting accuracy across programs.

Tracked portfolio milestones, dependencies and delivery commitments and coordinated governance approvals including GRAM (Group Risk Assessment Metrics ), ORO (Operational Risk Officer) and Product Owner attestations for regulatory and control checkpoints.

Supported audit and regulatory readiness through evidence collection, documentation management, control validation and SharePoint governance.



Created executive presentations, go-live readiness assessments and operating model documentation; facilitated collaboration across Business, Product, Technology, AI and Operations teams to resolve escalations and drive strategic change initiatives.

IT Consultant – PMO	Dec 2022 – Mar 2025

Northern Trust India, Bengaluru

Managed overall financial and budgeting activities for a multi-year regulatory change program valued over USD 2.5M, including vendor costs, forecasting and accrual tracking via Clarity, with weekly and monthly leadership dashboards.

Served as PMO for Strategic Execution Office (SEO), managing intake, prioritization and reporting of all new projects and programs across Asset Servicing, partnering with senior leadership on project selection.

Facilitated daily and weekly work-group meetings with Project Account Executives, Product Owners and Project Managers to track progress, resolve impediments and ensure on-time delivery.

Maintained project plans, RAID logs, cost and budgeting data across JIRA, Azure DevOps, Confluence and Clarity in line with company and market best practices.

Managed resource time allocation and reporting, partnering with project managers on cost-saving and resource optimization strategies.

Business Analyst/IT PMO	Aug 2019 – Dec 2022

Standard Chartered, Bengaluru

Delivered PMO support for the bank's global obsolescence program, driving removal and replacement of critical end-of-support systems across Standard Chartered's global technology estate.

Managed e-procurement, accruals, cost uploads and PO controls, reconciling Clarity financial reports against project budgets.

Tracked project financials including CAPEX/OPEX capitalization, provisioning and AMC management across the division; managed OKRs for transformation initiatives.

Led monthly finance reviews with workstream leads and PMs, managed resource allocations in Clarity and maintained forecast and budget summaries for senior stakeholder reviews.

Product Support Engineer	Jan 2015 – Aug 2019

Meltwater Software Pvt Ltd, Bengaluru

Generated Tableau-based BI reports providing KPIs and real-time system health insights for client accounts.

Investigated and resolved client tickets in JIRA, delivering clear technical communication to customers and vendors.

Supported database migrations, website configuration and application enhancements for global SaaS clients.

CERTIFICATIONS & ACHIEVEMENTS

Certified SAFe® Agilist – Leading SAFe®, Scaled Agile, Inc. (Oct 2024)

EDUCATION

Master of Computer Applications — Grade: 79.25% Jyoti Nivas College, Bengaluru (2012–2015)

Bachelor of Computer Applications — Grade: 85.6%

West Bengal University of Technology, Kolkata (2009–2011)

TOOLS & LANGUAGES

Tools: Clarity, JIRA, Azure DevOps (ADO), Confluence, SharePoint, MS Excel, Tableau

Languages: English, Hindi, Bengali
